value: A’dal places the word Mercy beside a threatened life. In the Shattered Halls, Kargath holds three prisoners and intends to execute them. A’dal calls them the seeker’s people but does not name their allegiance. The task asks that they be saved; its named proof is an unused executioner’s axe with no blood on the blade. The quest records the trial passed when the axe is returned, but gives no named count of survivors. We leave that uncertainty where the record leaves it.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Quest dialogue is transcribed from a secondary mirror of primary in-game text. No source dialogue is copied into public narration; compare to the original TBC client before review.
